PsychicRitualDef.label: human reconstitution
PsychicRitualDef.description:
Burn a shard and psychically reconstitute a colonist from the void's blueprints. Every scar, sickness and dark trait is rewritten away - even an oni infection or a creepjoiner's curse. For as long as the rite lasts, its power holds still any oni infection carried by the invoker, the target or the chanters.
But the void does not tolerate forgery: should the ritual fail on a doppelganger, its true form will surface immediately.
PsychicRitualDef.outcomeDescription: With the current quality, there's a {0} chance the reconstitution will succeed. A failure disintegrates a normal colonist - and a doppelganger transforms at once.
